name: aruba-clearpass
label: Aruba ClearPass
description: Aruba ClearPass is a policy management platform that enables businesses to effortlessly onboard new devices, grant varying access levels, and keep their networks secure. Aruba ClearPass connector performs actions like list guest and guest details, list endpoints and endpoint details etc.

fields.title: Server Address
fields.name: host
fields.description: IP address or FQDN of the Aruba ClearPass server to which to connect and perform the automated operations.

fields.title: Client ID
fields.name: client_id
fields.description: The client ID from your Aruba API client app definition.

fields.title: Authorization Grant Type
fields.name: auth_grant_type
fields.description: Select the Aruba ClearPass authentication type either Client Secret or Username-Password pair that you will use to access Aruba ClearPass.

Client Secret.title: Client Secret
Client Secret.name: client_secret
Client Secret.description: In the Client Secret field, specify the client secret from your Aruba API client app definition. The client secret is required if the API client definition is not configured as a public client.

Username/Password.title: Username
Username/Password.name: username
Username/Password.description: Enter the username to access the Aruba ClearPass server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

Username/Password.title: Password
Username/Password.name: password
Username/Password.description: Enter the password to access the Aruba ClearPass server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.description:
Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. 
By default, this option is set as True

operations.title: Get List of Guests
operations.description: Retrieves a collection of all currently managed guest accounts from Aruba ClearPass.

operations.title: Get Guest Details
operations.description: Retrieves details of a specific guest account from Aruba ClearPass based on the Guest ID you have specified.

parameters.title: Guest ID
parameters.name: guest_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the guest whose details you want to retrieve from Aruba ClearPass.
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the guest whose details you want to retrieve from Aruba ClearPass.

operations.title: List Endpoint
operations.description: Retrieves the list of all connected endpoints on the Aruba ClearPass network.

operations.title: Get Endpoint Detail
operations.description: Retrieves details of a specific endpoint from Aruba ClearPass based on the Endpoint ID you have specified.

parameters.title: Endpoint ID
parameters.name: endpoint_id
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the endpoint whose details you want to retrieve from Aruba ClearPass.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the endpoint whose details you want to retrieve from Aruba ClearPass.

operations.title: Update Endpoint Status
operations.description: Updates the status of a specific connected endpoint in the Aruba ClearPass network based on the Endpoint ID and status you have specified.

parameters.title: Endpoint ID
parameters.name: endpoint_id
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the endpoint whose status you want to update in the Aruba ClearPass network.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the endpoint whose status you want to update in the Aruba ClearPass network.

parameters.title: Endpoint Status
parameters.name: endpoint_status
parameters.description: Select the status that you want to update for the specific endpoint in the Aruba ClearPass network. You can choose from the following options: Known, Unknown, Disabled
parameters.tooltip: Select the status that you want to update for the specific endpoint in the Aruba ClearPass network. You can choose from the following options: Known, Unknown, Disabled

parameters.title: Description
parameters.name: description
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a description to add while updating the status of the specific endpoint in the Aruba ClearPass network.
parameters.tooltip: Specify a description to add while updating the status of the specific endpoint in the Aruba ClearPass network.

operations.title: List Sessions
operations.description: Retrieves a list of all active sessions from the Aruba ClearPass network.

parameters.title: Filter
parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
(Optional) Specify a criterion to filter the list of sessions retrieved from the Aruba ClearPass network. 
For filter syntax, refer to the Aruba ClearPass REST API filtering https://developer.arubanetworks.com/cppm/docs/rest-api-filtering.
parameters.tooltip:
Specify a criterion to filter the list of sessions retrieved from the Aruba ClearPass network. 
For filter syntax, refer to the Aruba ClearPass REST API filtering https://developer.arubanetworks.com/cppm/docs/rest-api-filtering.

operations.title: Terminate Sessions
operations.description: Terminates an active session in the Aruba ClearPass network based on the Session ID you have specified.

parameters.title: Session ID
parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the session to terminate from the Aruba ClearPass network.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the session to terminate from the Aruba ClearPass network.

operations.title: Disable Device
operations.description: Disables a device registered in Aruba ClearPass Guest based on the MAC address you have specified.

parameters.title: MAC Address
parameters.name: mac_address
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the MAC address of the device to disable from the Aruba ClearPass.
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify the MAC address of the device to disable from the Aruba ClearPass.

operations.title: Send Session COA by MAC
operations.description: Sends a RADIUS Change of Authorization (COA) to the Aruba ClearPass session based on the MAC address and COA Profile you have specified.

parameters.title: MAC Address
parameters.name: mac_address
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the MAC address to identify the Aruba ClearPass session.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the MAC address to identify the Aruba ClearPass session.

parameters.title: COA Profile
parameters.name: coa_profile
parameters.description: Specify the MAC address to identify the Aruba ClearPass session.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the MAC address to identify the Aruba ClearPass session.

operations.title: Get Device Profile
operations.description: Retrieves the attributes of a device profiled by Aruba ClearPass based on the MAC address or IP address you have specified.

parameters.title: MAC Address /IP Address
parameters.name: mac_or_ip
parameters.description: Specify the MAC or the IP Address to get attributes of a device from the Aruba ClearPass network.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the MAC or the IP Address to get attributes of a device from the Aruba ClearPass network.

operations.title: Get Endpoint Details by MAC Address
operations.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific endpoint from Aruba ClearPass based on the MAC address you have specified.

parameters.title: MAC Address
parameters.name: mac_address
parameters.description: Specify the MAC address of the endpoint for which you want to retrieve detailed information from Aruba ClearPass.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the MAC address of the endpoint for which you want to retrieve detailed information from Aruba ClearPass.

operations.title: Block Endpoint
operations.description: Blocks the endpoint based on the MAC address you have specified by setting the 'blacklisted' attribute to true.

parameters.title: MAC Address
parameters.name: mac_adress
parameters.description: Specify the MAC address of the endpoint that you want to block by setting its 'blacklisted' attribute to 'true' in Aruba ClearPass.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the MAC address of the endpoint that you want to block by setting its 'blacklisted' attribute to 'true' in Aruba ClearPass.

operations.title: Execute an API Request
operations.description: Executes any Aruba ClearPass API using the specified API method, endpoint, query parameters, and payload as input parameters.

parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.title: Endpoint
parameters.tooltip: Specify the Aruba ClearPass REST API endpoint for the action you want to perform. For example, '/api/guest' or '/api/session?calculate_count=true' Note: Do not pass the full endpoint path, which starts with the host or server URL.
parameters.description: Specify the Aruba ClearPass REST API endpoint for the action you want to perform. For example, '/api/guest' or '/api/session?calculate_count=true' Note: Do not pass the full endpoint path, which starts with the host or server URL.

parameters.name: method
parameters.title: Method
parameters.tooltip: Select the HTTP method that you want to use to execute the API request.
parameters.description: Select the HTTP method that you want to use to execute the API request.

parameters.title: Query Parameters
parameters.name: query_params
parameters.tooltip: Specify the REST API query parameters object in JSON format.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the REST API query parameters object in JSON format.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.title: Payload
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify the payload needed for the RESP API call. Use empty brackets if there is no payload.
parameters.description: Specify the payload needed for the RESP API call. Use empty brackets if there is no payload.
